dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon heard that the Frostmoon Scions worship the moon. So, what do you think they get up to during the daytime?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uhh... just go about their normal lives, I guess?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way, not if they're up all night worshiping! Paimon bets they have a really unusual daily routine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like, uh... When the sun comes up, they probably shapeshift into huge boulders and take a nice long nap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When night falls, they wake back up again — and with a swish and a swoosh, they're back in human form! Then, they sneak away to start getting up to their secret, mysterious work...

choices.text: So let me guess — the worst-case scenario for them is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, exactly! See, you got it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, I got it... You're getting mixed up between "Scion" and "Sayu" again.

choices.text: Blowing through nap time and doing an all-day and all-nighter?
